text:
maya-cs: Pinehaven asked for a temporary regional throughput bump and IP allowlist for their pilot launch tomorrow morning. they're hitting qps limits during load tests. can ops provision a provisional lift + CIDR allowlist?

maya-cs: summary — customer_id=PH-2048, env=prod-pilot, regions requested=[us-west-2, ap-south-1], requested_qps=1200 (current=300), ttl=72h auto-revoke, cidrs=[198.51.100.0/24, 203.0.113.48/28]

simon-ops: got it. quick Qs: is this per-route or account-wide? any IP pinning already? and do we need to open regional egress peering or is routing via their proxy?

maya-cs: account-wide for now (they want to stress entire model surface). no existing pinning. they'll route from their proxy in us-west-2 and another proxy in mumbai. they requested header-based allowlist too (x-client-id: pinehaven-prod).

lena-network: tagging in network — do they require mTLS between our edge and their proxy? if yes we need cert exchange + longer lead time.

maya-cs: not mTLS for this pilot, just CIDR + header whitelist. we do have a signed NDA so sharing IPs is fine.

simon-ops: OK. i'll propose a safe rollout: 1) increase account qps to 1200 in us-west-2 only, 2) add the two CIDRs to allowlist with description "pinehaven pilot temporary", 3) set header-based bypass for x-client-id:pinehaven-prod, 4) auto-revoke in 72h and notify cs channel 24h before expiry. sound good?

maya-cs: perfect. also flagged renewal risk — they're on month-to-month now and will likely commit if pilot looks stable. please include a note on renewal ops ticket.

simon-ops: working on the patch now. API call i'll run (internal):

```
POST /internal/admin/quotas
{
  "customer_id": "PH-2048",
  "region": "us-west-2",
  "quota_type": "account_qps",
  "value": 1200,
  "ttl_hours": 72,
  "note": "pinehaven pilot provisional bump — cs:maya"
}
```

simon-ops: and allowlist entry payload:

```
POST /internal/config/allowlists
{
  "customer_id": "PH-2048",
  "entries": [
    {"cidr": "198.51.100.0/24", "desc": "pinehaven pilot"},
    {"cidr": "203.0.113.48/28", "desc": "pinehaven pilot"}
  ],
  "header_whitelist": [{"header": "x-client-id", "value": "pinehaven-prod"}],
  "auto_revoke_hours": 72
}
```

deploy-bot: change-request received: quota-bump PH-2048 us-west-2 -> 1200 (ttl 72h). request id: dr-3276543210-1

deploy-bot: change-request received: allowlist-add PH-2048 2 entries + header whitelist. request id: dr-3276543210-2

simon-ops: applied quota bump on edge controlplane for us-west-2. confirmed with metrics: pre-change qps cap=300, post-change cap=1200. rolling active config now.

deploy-bot: dr-3276543210-1: APPLY SUCCESS (ts=3276543242) — effective immediately.

simon-ops: added allowlist entries + header rule. here's the admin audit entry: 
```
AUDIT: user=simon-ops action=allowlist_add customer=PH-2048 entries=2 header_whitelist=1 ttl=72h ref=dr-3276543210-2
```

deploy-bot: dr-3276543210-2: APPLY SUCCESS (ts=3276543246) — auto-revoke scheduled for 72h (expires at ts=327683... ).

maya-cs: amazing — can you confirm we'll get a reminder 24h before expiry in #customer-success and that the auto-revoke creates a follow-up ticket if they ask to extend?

simon-ops: yep. scheduled reminders created and linked to ops ticket OPS-4587. extension requests will create a child ticket and page cs-oncall if >72h requested.

lena-network: noted on network side — we didn't change peering. if routing issues crop up in ap-south-1 we should consider adding a soft-provision in that region too. i'll watch health metrics.

maya-cs: i'll follow up with Pinehaven PM to run another burst at +10% magnitude after 15m to confirm stability. i'll log pilot feedback into the renewal playbook. :thumbsup:

simon-ops: closing loop here — changes live, monitoring in place, ops ticket logged. ping me if any errors.

maya-cs: thanks all, huge help. will update thread with customer feedback post-burst.

simon-ops: ack.

maya-cs: FYI — Pinehaven asked if we can capture latency p50/p95 during the pilot for the renewal deck. simon-ops can we enable a short retention window for those traces?

simon-ops: sure — enabling 48h retention on traces for PH-2048 and attaching the snapshot to OPS-4587.

maya-cs: perfect, thanks!
